result.summary: Updates the functional test framework to wait for all enabled background indices (such as txindex and blockfilterindex) to sync by default during node startup and when calling `sync_all()`. It cleans up redundant manual index-synchronization calls across multiple test files and removes the standalone `sync_txindex` helper.
result.problem: Functional tests relying on background indices can race against wallet or RPC operations if an index has not caught up to the chain tip, causing intermittent test flakes such as missing block filters during fast wallet rescans (#36564). Previously, tests had to remember to call manual `wait_until` index checks or helpers.
evidence: PR description links to failure report in issue #36564 and provides a reproduction snippet using a sleep in `TraceThread` that triggers `(WARNING: block filter not found!)`.
Commit fa74dc72d9 notes: 'The tests already wait for the mempool and blocks after start and after mining, so they should wait for indexes as well to avoid intermittent test failures.'
result.scope_notes: Touches 18 test files, primarily replacing manual `wait_until` index checks with the centralized default wait in `BitcoinTestFramework` and `TestNode`.
result.changed_since_previous: None. The diff confirms the previous description.
result.card: This pull request configures functional test node startup and sync helpers to automatically wait for background index synchronization, resolving intermittent test flakes caused by race conditions. It addresses issue #36564 where wallet rescans failed due to block filters lagging behind the chain tip. Redundant manual index sync logic across 18 test files is removed, with no changes to production node code.

risk.why: A mistake would only cause functional test timeouts or CI failures without impacting release binaries or consensus.
